description_excerpt: Job Description This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement. As a Embedded Android Developer, your typical work activities include: • Participate in every stage of the software development, from requirement analysis, design and implementation to module and system verification. • Develop firmware + middleware + OS services to support in monitoring thermal, voltage, reset reason, system’s state, as well as giving instructions to keep system safe, stable & reliable. • The focused technology in this position is Embedded Android SW development. •…
